name: Field instrumentation
principle: Field instruments sense process conditions and transmit standardised signals (4-20 mA with HART, or fieldbus) to the control and safety systems. Pressure, temperature, level and flow dominate: differential-pressure transmitters with orifice plates or integrated DP flowmeters, coriolis and magnetic flowmeters, thermocouples and RTDs, radar and guided-wave level, and vibration sensors on machinery. Selection trades accuracy, rangeability, process compatibility, Ex protection and SIL capability, with diagnostics (NAMUR NE 107 status) reporting instrument health to the DCS.

process_steps.name: Primary element senses pressure, temperature, level or flow
Signal conditioned and transmitted digitally or by 4-20 mA
Control or safety system consumes the measurement
Onboard diagnostics report status per NAMUR NE 107

limitations: installation effects (straight-run lengths, nozzle geometry) dominate flowmeter accuracy more than the meter itself
impulse lines freeze and plug; direct-mount and electronic DP reduce that exposure
advantages: smart diagnostics turn instrument faults from surprises into work orders
one transmitter family serves control, safety and custody duties

sources.note: NAMUR NE 107 instrument diagnostics framework, read 2026-11-07
